open_observations: Two of five full platform invocations each failed a single worker-driven test (transport journey; journey-API small-battery case) while other science and browser workloads ran. Both runs recorded a run in state FAILED (fail-closed: never a wrong PASS). The exception type of the first is unknown; the second logged AssertionError. Neither reproduced in isolation, under parallel stress, or in the next full run. Root cause is not established. An earlier candidate recorded one similar sanitized worker error that also did not reproduce.
